The table-heavy improvement target is 0 pp by explicit owner decision (this session, 2026-08-18): the v1 corpus's cleanly ruled tables put the legacy extractor at cell F1 1.0 in the S6 smoke run, so parity at ceiling satisfies the improvement leg, the headroom caveat is recorded in the decision, and a docling-lab-fixtures.v2 table-hardness follow-up (unruled, merged-cell, rotated-header tables) is queued in the issues inbox.
